message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz can (or 2 cups) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot or celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 leaf, ¼ cup veggies |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (optional)** | Butter | 2 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 2 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 2 cups |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | pinch |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |

### Quick Steps
1. **Cook the meat sauce**: Sauté onion, garlic, and optional veggies in olive oil; add ground meat until browned. Stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min.
2. **Prepare ricotta mix**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, pepper.
3. **Make béchamel** (if using): Melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season.
4. **Layer**: Start with a thin sauce layer, then noodles, ricotta, meat sauce, béchamel (optional), cheese. Repeat until all layers used, finishing with cheese on top.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
